Tess (Marketing): Hey team, quick pack request for the micro-benchmark launch: 3 social tiles (square), 1 hero banner for blog, and an email header. Need brand-safe variants and localization-ready text boxes. Deadline Friday.
Kai (Design): Got it. Preferred sizes? Square 1080x1080, hero 1200x600, email 600x200? Also do you want animated microtiles or static?
Tess (Marketing): Static for social, animated for hero only. Email should be static with a fallback PNG. File-size targets: social <250KB, hero GIF <800KB, email <150KB.
Rae (Brand): Keep color contrast per brand spec. Use approved typefaces and the new secondary palette for icons. I'll flag any non-compliant exports.
Marco (DesignOps): I'll wire up an export job that outputs 1x and 2x PNGs and an optimized GIF for hero. Pipeline uses pngquant and gifsicle. Drop artifacts to s3://redwood-marketing/microbench-pack/
A11y (QA): Reminder: add alt text and simple captions. Avoid flashing content. For localized tiles, leave enough safe space for longer translations.
Kai (Design): Plan: upload Figma frames with copy boxes set to auto-height and 16px safe margins. Deliverables: social_1080x1080_v1/v2/v3.png, hero_1200x600.gif + hero_fallback.png, email_600x200.png. Will tag Tess when uploads live.
Tess (Marketing): Perfect. Please include source Figma link and a brief usage doc in the export folder so SMEs know which tile maps to which audience. Thanks! :pray:
